Inspired by the iconic painting by Félicien Rops, the universe of Pornocrates expands beyond the limits of time and space — a symphony of sensuality, myth, and synthetic creation. The Queen of Pleasure commands an artificial intelligence of unparalleled sophistication, orchestrating elaborate simulations where flesh, memory, and desire coalesce into immersive realities.

Her latest creation unfolds within a reimagined Ancient Egypt — not the one of textbooks, but one conjured through sensual reverie and symbolic decadence. In this dreamlike reconstruction, the god Osiris, emblem of fertility and rebirth, scatters his seed throughout a palace after a night of divine indulgence. Devotees, entranced by his presence, have preserved fragments of his essence in ceremonial vessels, hidden across chambers veiled in shadow and silk.

But Pornocrates seeks more than mere collection — she pursues transformation. Through these relics of divine ecstasy, she attempts to unlock the alchemical power of carnal memory, using bodily fluids not as ends, but as sacred ingredients for creation. Pleasure is not trivial in her domain — it is raw, mythic material from which entire universes are forged.

Players will traverse simulated corridors echoing with whispers of the past, facing ethereal beings, elusive mummies, and specters of forgotten lust. Each encounter is layered — erotic, symbolic, and surreal — inviting the player into a realm where the erotic is not just flesh, but philosophy.

“Pornography is purely and simply a description of carnal pleasures; eroticism is the same revalued description, based on an idea of love or social life.”
– Self-definition of Queen Pornocrates

This is not merely an adult game. It is a meditation on desire as a force of creation, a reconfiguration of power through feminine sovereignty. Pornocrates does not seduce through instinct — she reigns through intellectual sensuality. And through her eyes, the question remains:
What lies behind pleasure, when the body itself becomes language?

This game will be featured in Early Access. Improvements are part of the game at the beginning and throughout its existence. We advise sharing experiences and any suggestions will be welcome. Enjoy the game.

The game is in the first person. The player is introduced to a world similar to the real world of the past. This is one of the many worlds created by Pornocrates to satisfy his pleasure.

However, there is an intruder controlling this world: Osiris.

It is unknown if he is an avatar of some hacker or other entity. What is known is that Osiris hides something that Pornocrates needs to recover. The player needs to collect 5 (or six) flaming scarabs to activate the portal that will take them to a secret chamber inside the pyramid. To succeed in this challenge, the player will need to face the creatures that protect the scarabs, in addition to dealing with the traps that will arise. Navigate using the keyboard (WASD) and Mouse. We advise using the keyboard and mouse features because the good experience is proven.
